content: ReportLab Paragraph accepts HTML-like markup. User data embedded in Paragraph text that contains < > & characters should be XML-escaped (using xml.sax.saxutils.escape) before passing to Paragraph(). The _build_pdf in scheduled_reports_service.py currently wraps all values in str() before Paragraph() without escaping — so AI narrative text (which has already been sanitised via _sanitise() removing <>{} chars) is safe to embed directly. However, to be extra safe, narrative text should be passed through str() and the _sanitise step ensures no XML-breaking chars remain.
